description: One flip-flop in 2HP that works as a toggle or a data type by switch, with set and reset inputs that override both

params.text: Chooses what the T/D input means: T toggles the output on a clock while T/D is high, D copies T/D to the output on a clock
Sets the output high by hand
Sets the output low by hand
Chooses how the enable input is read: as a gate that disables the module while it is high, or as a trigger that flips between enabled and disabled

inputs.text: In T mode a high here lets the next clock flip the output; in D mode its level is what the next clock copies to the output
A rising edge acts on the T/D input; with this jack empty it reads T/D itself, so in T mode one signal alone flips the output
A high here sets the output high and holds it, overriding the clock and T/D
A high here sets the output low and holds it, overriding the clock and T/D
Stops the module reacting to any of its other inputs while it says disabled, read as a gate or a trigger according to the button beside it

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the flip-flop is set and 0V while it is clear
Carries 10V while the flip-flop is clear and 0V while it is set
Fires a 1ms pulse each time the main output changes, in either direction

notes: the module is monophonic throughout; a polyphonic signal on any input is read on channel 1 only
at least one output must be patched for the module to run at all
holding Set and Reset high together is an undefined state: a red light beside the Q label comes on and the outputs are frozen until one of them drops, unless the menu says otherwise
in T mode with a clock in the T/D input alone, the main output is that clock halved and the inverted output is the same divided clock shifted by half a step
menu: Enable/disable high-gate: Will disable (default), Will enable — chooses which way round a gate on the enable input reads
Undefined output (SR-mode): Unchanged (default), Q=Low / !Q=Low, Q=High / !Q=Low, Q=Low / !Q=High, Q=High / !Q=High — sets what the two outputs carry while Set and Reset are both high
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it
Trigger-high output-level — sets the voltage a trigger pulse carries during its 1ms high phase, 10V unless you change it
Trigger-low output-level — sets the voltage a trigger output carries between pulses, 0V unless you change it

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V, read as low; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the T/D input; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V, read as low; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V, read as low; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads enabled; a negative voltage does nothing here.
